commands.cannotPause: Goal is already {status} — nothing to pause.
commands.cannotResume: Cannot resume a {status} goal. Create a new one with `/goal '<'text>`.
commands.createUsage: Usage: `/goal '<'what you want to accomplish>`. Example: `/goal write a haiku about winter`.
commands.created: 🎯 **Goal active** — {maxTurns, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}} budget, {maxTokensK, number}k token budget.
commands.createdHint: The agent will continue toward this goal automatically. Pause with `/goal pause` · stop with `/goal stop` · update with `/goal update '<'new text>`.
commands.needSession: Start a chat session first — `/goal` operates inside an active session.
commands.noActiveGoal: No active goal in this session. Start one with `/goal '<'what you want to accomplish>`.
commands.objectiveUnchanged: Objective unchanged (matches the current one) or goal is no longer mutable.
commands.objectiveUpdated: Objective updated. The model will be told about the change on the next turn.
commands.paused: Goal paused — {turns}/{maxTurns} turns used. Resume with `/goal resume`.
commands.remoteNotAllowed: Changing a goal from this device needs remote control. Turn it on for this device in the desktop's paired devices.
commands.resumed: Goal resumed. The loop will continue on the next turn.
commands.stopped: Goal stopped after {turns, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}}.
commands.streaming: The current turn is still streaming — `/goal` waits for the response to finish before changing the active goal.
commands.updateNoGoal: No active goal — create one first with `/goal '<'text>`.

config.adaptivePacingHint: The model suggests the next continuation delay (1–60 min); it can only slow the loop, never speed it below the minimum interval.
config.completionPromiseHint: When set, the goal only completes after the model emits this exact token in a verification turn — guards against false 'done' verdicts.
config.inlineStopHint: Appended to the system prompt. Example: 'or after producing 3 haikus'.
config.maxBudgetUsdHint: Hard USD ceiling for a single turn. The turn halts if its cost crosses this. 0 = no cost ceiling (turn + token budgets still apply).
config.maxJudgeFailuresHint: Consecutive JSON parse failures before auto-pause (fail-OPEN).
config.maxPromiseDenialsHint: Failed verification turns before the gate is overridden and the goal completes anyway.
config.maxTokensHint: Hard cap on cumulative tokens billed against this goal.
config.readOnly: This goal has ended — its settings are kept as a record and can't be changed.
config.requireAcceptanceHint: A judged completion pauses for your accept / request-changes instead of finishing on its own.
config.riskGatingHint: Automatically require acceptance (and, for high-risk goals you run yourself, a per-turn hold) when the objective or this session's tools look risky. Turning this off never removes a checkpoint you set yourself.

verification.disableConfirm: Disable this verifier? The goal will resume as active, and the current completion candidate will not be completed automatically.
verification.hint: Only published Workflows whose input and output schemas match the Goal verification contract are available.
verification.label: Completion verification workflow
verification.retryRunning: Verification is still running on the desktop. Its result will show here when it finishes.

judge.heading: Judge
judge.invalidModel: This judge model isn't offered by any configured provider — goals will fall back to the chat model.
judge.maxTokensHint: Cap on the judge's reply. The judge answers in one line — 200 is plenty.
judge.modelHint: Model that decides whether the goal is done. Leave on the chat model unless you want a cheaper/faster judge.
judge.noModels: No models available. Configure a provider first.
judge.promptOverrideHint: Replaces the built-in judge instructions. Must still ask for a one-line JSON verdict.
judge.temperatureHint: 0 is deterministic (recommended). Higher loosens the verdict.

launcher.description: Persistent chat goals. Set an objective with /goal and the agent auto-continues until a judge confirms it's done, or budgets / timeouts kick in.

objective.hint: The agent is told about the change on its next turn. ⌘/Ctrl + Enter saves.

objective.unchanged: Nothing changed — the objective is the same, or the goal has ended.
objective.updated: Objective updated. The agent will see it on its next turn.

overview.foregroundDormancy: Interactive goals advance only while the app is open; closing it pauses progress until you reopen this chat. Scheduled and headless goals continue on their own.

pacing.manualContinueHint: When on, the loop waits for you to click Continue on the goal pill each turn.
pacing.quietHoursHint: Pause auto-continuation during this window (uses your timezone).
